```{r cargar_clase1}
load("../output/clase1_clustering.RData")
```

```{r}
table(Idents(obj))
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
makers_0 <- FindMarkers(obj, ident.1 = "0", only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25)
FeaturePlot(obj, features = "Pou3f2", reduction = "tsne")
VlnPlot(obj, features = "Fam84a", pt.size = 0)
```
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
markers <- FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25)
markers_sig <- markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, 
                                  avg_log2FC > 1, pct.1 > pct.2)

top3 <- markers_sig %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 3) %>% ungroup() %>% pull(gene)
DotPlot(obj, features = top3) + RotatedAxis()
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
FeaturePlot(obj, features = top3[40:42], reduction = "umap")
VlnPlot(obj, features = top3[1:3], pt.size = 0)
```
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
obj_h <- ScaleData(obj, features = top3)
DoHeatmap(obj_h, features = top3) 
```


# Parte II

```{r instalar_referencia, eval=FALSE}
BiocManager::install("scRNAseq", update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
```

```{r cargar_referencia}
library(scRNAseq)

# Referencia de mesencéfalo embrionario de ratón
sce_ref <- LaMannoBrainData("mouse-embryo", ensembl = FALSE, location = FALSE)
sce_ref <- sce_ref[, !is.na(sce_ref$Cell_type)]
rownames(sce_ref) <- make.unique(rownames(sce_ref))

referencia <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(counts = as(assay(sce_ref, "counts"), "dgCMatrix"),
                                 project = "LaManno")
referencia$cell_type <- as.character(sce_ref$Cell_type)
table(referencia$cell_type)
```
```{r}
referencia <- NormalizeData(referencia)
referencia <- FindVariableFeatures(referencia)
referencia <- ScaleData(referencia)
referencia <- RunPCA(referencia, npcs = 50)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
Idents(obj) <- "seurat_clusters"

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = referencia, query = obj, 
                               reference.reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20)

pred <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, refdata = referencia$cell_type, dims = 1:20)
obj <- AddMetaData(obj, metadata = pred)
obj$cell_type <- obj$predicted.id

table(obj$cell_type)

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) | 
  DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type", label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
concordancia <- prop.table(table(Cluster = obj$seurat_clusters,
                                Tipo_predicho = obj$cell_type), margin = 1) * 100
porcentajes <- as.data.frame(concordancia)
ggplot(porcentajes, aes(Cluster, Tipo_predicho, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#377EB8", mid = "white", high = "#E41A1C",
                       midpoint = 50, limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 50, 100), name = "% células") +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Tipo predicho") + theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
summary(obj$prediction.score.max)
VlnPlot(obj, features = "prediction.score.max", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0)
```
```{r}
metadata <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame()
id <- match(colnames(obj), rownames(metadata))
obj$Mouse <- metadata$Mouse[id]
table(obj$Mouse)
```

```{r}
conteos <- table(Muestra = obj$Mouse, tipo_celular = obj$cell_type)
prop <- prop.table(conteos, margin = 1) * 100
conteos
comp <- as.data.frame(prop)
ggplot(comp, aes(Muestra, Freq, fill = tipo_celular)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 1)
```
